g.text: Observed post-GC heap: whole game JVM
Same machine, seed and requested workload per case. Median of 4 independent JVM run means; whiskers show run min–max.
See methods and validation tables; no confidence intervals are implied.
At least 100 post-workload server ticks before GC. Includes world/client data; client chunk counts may differ.
Not engine-only memory or equal-scene memory efficiency.
